senses.gloss: m., pl. יוֹחֲסִים, (יָחַס) יוֹחֲסִין genealogical records, traced genealogy.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:1">Kidd. IV, 1</cite> <he>עשרה י׳ עלו וכ׳</he> ten classes of Jews of traced genealogy went up from Babylonian captivity.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:2:13">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>מגילת י׳ מצאו וכ׳</he> a roll containing genealogical records was found &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:8:6">Y. Succ. V, end, 55ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:5:1">Cant. R. to V, 5</cite> <cite ref="U01401"><he>שלשלת</he></cite> (<cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>)<he>י׳</he> the genealogical chain; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Gen. R. s. 82</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Ib.</cite> <he>בכורת י׳</he> the genealogical privileges of the first-born, opp. to <he>בכורת ממון</he> the material privileges (double-share). Ruth R., end <he>מה אתם יש לכם י׳</he> what records have you to show?—
<cite ref="Pesachim 62b:15">Pes. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>מיום שנגנז ספר י׳</he> since the Book of Genealogy (a commentary to Chronicles) was suppressed (or disappeared, in the Roman days).
<cite ref="Pesachim 62b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ניתני לי מר ספר י׳</he> teach me the book of records (Chronicles); a. e.—V. <cite ref="J00273"><he>יִחוּס</he></cite>.
